name: store-week
title: The store audit week
subtitle: Fictional demo until your records are imported. Scores exclude not-applicable answers.

sections.title: Visit coverage
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,last_visit,next_visit,coverage from store.coverage order by code

sections.title: Audit scores
sections.sql: select code,site,status,unanswered,critical_failures,score_pct,verdict from store.scorecard order by code

sections.title: Repeat failures
sections.sql: select * from store.repeat_failures order by site,check_code

sections.title: Open and completed work
sections.sql: select code,site,title,owner,due_date,state,revisit_on from store.action_register where state<>'verified' order by due_date

sections.title: Checks needing review
sections.sql: select * from store.compliance_findings order by rule,site
